scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ocean/core run build && pnpm --filter ocean run build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ocean/core run build && pnpm --filter ocean run dev
scripts.start: pnpm build && pnpm --filter ocean run start
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ocean/core run build && pnpm --filter ocean run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:style && pnpm check:unused && pnpm check:privacy && pnpm check:skills && pnpm check:tasks && pnpm check:package && pnpm check:system
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter ocean run test
